title: Days Covered by an Entitlement Restoration After a Reduction
content:
**Education Procedures, Part 7 — Days covered by a restoration (Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606).**

**7.01 Principle.** The days a restoration covers depend on the last date of attendance and on how far the term's own charge reached, a restoration never giving back days that were never charged.

**7.02 Terms.** The *term* is the term of the latest reduction, from its term start to its term end with both days counted. The *days through the last date of attendance* run from the term start through the last date of attendance, both counted; the *days after it* are the rest of the term. The *entitlement charged for the term* is the charge entries for training that began in the twelve months before today, their days added together. The *days the charge covers* are the entitlement charged divided by the certified daily charge. The *kept-credit charge* is the daily charge of the credits remaining plus the credits excused in a restoration, on the same daily scale as the credits remaining (nothing when no credits are kept; 0.25 a day below half of the term's full-time measure; 0.5 a day from half to below three quarters of it; 0.75 a day from three quarters to below the full measure; 1 a day at or above it).

**7.03 Rule.**
(a) When the latest reduction has a last date of attendance inside its term and the entitlement charged for the term covers every day of the term at the certified charge: the days through the last date of attendance are restored at the difference between the certified charge and the kept-credit charge, and the days after it at the difference between the certified and the remaining charges; the two products are added together.
(b) When the last date of attendance is inside the term but that charge ran out before the term end: the days after the last date of attendance are restored only up to the day the charge covers — that is, only as many of them as the days the charge covers exceed the days through the last date of attendance, and never fewer than none — and the days through the last date of attendance as in (a).
(c) Otherwise, for a reduction whose last date of attendance is not inside its term: every day of the term is restored at the difference between the certified and the remaining charges.

**7.04 Worked cases (hypothetical 100-day term; certified charge 1, remaining charge 0.5, kept-credit charge 0.75; last date of attendance on day 40).**

| Entitlement charged for the term | Rule | Days restored before rounding |
|---|---|---|
| 100 days | (a) | 40 times 0.25 plus 60 times 0.5: 10 plus 30, 40 |
| 70 days | (b) | 40 times 0.25 plus 30 times 0.5: 10 plus 15, 25 |
| 40 days | (b) | 40 times 0.25 plus none: 10 |
| Any, last date of attendance before the term start | (c) | 100 times 0.5: 50 |

**7.05 Days of training recorded on the restoration entry.** The restoration entry records as its first day of training the term start when the days through the last date of attendance are restored at a difference above none, or when the last date of attendance is not inside the term, and otherwise the day after the last date of attendance; it records as its last day of training the term end, or, when the term's charge ran out before the term end, the last day that charge covers, counting the term start as the first day covered.

Put the other way: the entry begins on the day after the last date of attendance only when that date is inside the term and the days through it are restored at no difference; in every other case it begins on the term start. It ends on the term end unless the term's charge ran out first.

**7.06 Recorded days illustrated (hypothetical 100-day term from January 1 to April 10 of a non-leap year; last date of attendance on day 40, February 9).**

| Certified charge | Kept-credit charge | Entitlement charged for the term | First day recorded | Last day recorded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.75 | 100 days, every day covered | January 1 (term start) | April 10 (term end) |
| 0.75 | 0.75 | 75 days, every day covered | February 10 (day after the last date of attendance) | April 10 (term end) |
| 1 | 0.75 | 70 days, covering 70 days | January 1 (term start) | March 11 (day 70) |
| 0.75 | 0.75 | 54 days, covering 72 days | February 10 (day after the last date of attendance) | March 13 (day 72) |
| Any, last date of attendance before the term start | — | 100 days at a charge of 1 | January 1 (term start) | April 10 (term end) |
